newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: At least five killed in Colombian prison riot.
newsitem.headline: At least five killed in Colombian prison riot.

text.p: At least five inmates were killed and 18 injured when guards opened fire in an attempt to quell a prison riot in Colombia's southwest city of Popayan overnight, authorities said on Tuesday.
Police and prison officials said the riot erupted late on Monday and rebellious inmates continued to control most of the San Isidro prison on Tuesday morning.
Col. Guillermo Gutierrez, the top-ranking police official in Cauca province of which Popayan is the capital, said the bodies of three prisoners killed were still inside the jail on Tuesday morning.
Two others were in a local hospital along with about eight of the 18 injured, Gutierrez told Reuters.
He said the dead and injured had all been hit by gunshots fired by prison guards at the height of the riot.

"It seems there was an attempt to stage a breakout," Gutierrez said, seeking to explain what radio reports from the scene described as excessive use of force and indiscriminate shooting by the guards at the prison, which houses around 1,200 inmates.
The latest prison riot followed a bloody uprising at the main penitentiary in the northern city of Valledupar on April 3 in which three guards and a police office were killed.
